title: Flour
html:
Farinha
Empilhável 64
Transitável
Tempo fresco 180 days
Tempo de apodrecimento 14 days
Taxa de apodrecimento 0.25
Itens

Flour is an ingredient made by grinding grain in a quern . It is primarily used for baking and alcohol brewing .

Contents

  • 1 Creation

    • 2.1 Food
    • 2.2 Alcohol
    • 2.3 Composting
  • 3 Preservation

Creation

Flour is made by grinding 1 piece of grain in a quern . Cassava must be soaked and dried before it can be ground.

Usage

Food

1 portion of flour can be combined with 1L of water to make dough. The water must be stored in a container , such as a bowl , jug , or bucket , and then added to the crafting grid.

Dough can be heated in a clay oven to make bread or heated over a firepit to make charred bread. It is also used to make pies , which are baked in a clay oven.

When cooked, flour has the same initial nutritional properties as its respective gain, generally increased by 300% in the final product.

Alcohol

Flour and water can be fermented into ale and further distilled into spirits.

Composting

Making dough, which lasts 2 days and has a transition ratio of 1, is a highly efficient method to create rot for composting . 10 dough produces 10 rot; the same amount is produced by 20 vegetables or 40 fruits .

Preservation

Flour is fresh for 180 days, which can be extended by storing it in a storage vessel and a cellar .
